messages:
max: heads up — our node sample-app is printing user emails in DEBUG logs during onboarding. i thought redaction was on by default. LOG_LEVEL=debug seems to bypass the redactor for some entries. repro below.

sarah: ugh. saw something similar in the android sample e2e last week. pretty sure it's an ordering issue with the OTEL hook init vs logger creation. if the logger is created before the req-id hook attaches, no req_id gets injected so the redactor doesn't catch it.

eli: i dug in and can reproduce. minimal repro:
```bash
# start sample app with debug
LOG_LEVEL=debug node src/server.js
# trigger onboarding flow that logs the user object
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/onboard -d '{"email":"test@example.com"}'
```
logs show: 
```
DEBUG onboarding: creating user { id: 123, email: "test@example.com" }
```
No req_id prefix.

eli: root cause = sdk autoinit race. node SDK calls logger.setup() during module import, while our otel hook (which injects req_id into log context) runs later in the async bootstrap. when logger already formatted the message it never sees the context. python sample avoids this because we init tracing before creating the logger.

maria: thanks for the repro. two short-term mitigations: 1) ensure sample apps explicitly call await tracing.init() before require('./logger') OR 2) enable synchronous redaction fallback that scrubs known PII patterns even without req_id. neither is ideal but both reduce blast radius.

max: which option is less surprising for first-time users? opt 1 is more correct but something we should document in quickstarts. opt 2 is safer for prod but could mask root cause.

eli: agree. propose we:
- patch node SDK to delay logger final-format until hooks run (small change)
- add a bold note in onboarding guide: "init observability before creating global logger"
- ship a temporary server-side scrub for DEBUG logs in sample apps

sarah: +1 on docs. also worth adding a test in sample-app e2e that asserts presence of "req_id=" prefix in all app logs. catches regressions early.

maria: i'll open a ticket and assign. DEVEX-3487 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEVEX-3487 (node sdk logger/otel init ordering). tagging @eli to lead the fix.

devex-bot: created DEVEX-3487 and linked PR template. cc @maria @eli :paperclip:

max: quick question — do we need an opt-in for redaction on DEBUG? some customers want full unredacted debug in test envs. should be env-driven.

eli: yeah we should respect REDACTION_OVERRIDE env. plan: default redaction on even for DEBUG in our sample apps; SDK default remains redact=false for debug but provide easy toggle via env var and clear docs.

deploy-bot: note: sample-app patch branch pushed to staging for testing. build #2026.3.23-15: queued. :rocket:

max: cool. i'll update the quickstart with the explicit init order and a short note about the env toggle. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
